# Codex icon source

`jeebis-codex.svg` is derived from the vendored Omarchy runtime's
`shell/plugins/agents/assets/codex.svg`
(upstream: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy).
Jeebis changes only the monochrome white fill to blue (#8cc8ff);
the shape is unchanged. The upstream MIT copyright and permission notice
is preserved in `LICENSE.omarchy`.
